basics.name: Abiodun Modupe, Ph.D.
basics.label: Computer Science · Artificial Intelligence · Cybersecurity · Natural Language Processing
basics.summary: Researcher in trustworthy and responsible AI, AI for cybersecurity and digital forensics, secure agentic systems, and multilingual and low-resource NLP. U.S. Permanent Resident, authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship. Based in Richmond, Texas.

work.name: Department of Computer Science, University of Pretoria
work.position: Lecturer & MIT Big Data Science Program Coordinator
work.summary: Teaching remotely from the United States since 2026 while continuing program coordination and student advising.
highlights: Courses: COS760 Natural Language Processing; COS781 Data Mining; COS801 Deep Learning; MIT801 Machine and Statistical Learning; MIT808 Data Science Capstone; MIT807 Mini-Dissertation (module coordinator).
Coordinate the part-time MIT Big Data Science program: admissions, orientation, progression, timetabling, capstone and mini-dissertation processes.
Advise annual cohorts of approximately 45–50 students.
Completed supervision: 10 MIT mini-dissertations, 4 M.Sc. dissertations, and 1 Ph.D.; current doctoral (co-)supervision at the University of Pretoria and North-West University.
